title: Crystallization of Zika virus NS2B-NS3 protease (PDB ID: 8PN6)
author: Xiaomin Ni

steps.title: Prepare crystallization screen
steps.instruction: Mix stock solutions to obtain a screen containing 30% w/v PEG 2000, 0.2 M ammonium sulfate, and 0.1 M sodium acetate at pH 4.8. Use 1 M ammonium sulfate, 1 M sodium acetate (pH 4.8), and 50% w/v PEG 2000 as stocks. Prepare at least 2.88 mL of this screen; store in a Duran bottle or aliquot into a 96‑deep‑well block and keep at 4 °C for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Prepare protein sample
steps.instruction: Ensure the Zika NS2B‑NS3 protease is at 15 mg/mL concentration; aliquot 43.2 µL of this sample for the crystallization experiment.

steps.title: Add reservoir solution
steps.instruction: Using a 100 µL multi‑channel pipette, dispense 30 µL of the prepared crystallization screen into each reservoir well of a SwissCI 3‑lens plate.

steps.title: Set up sitting‑drop vapor diffusion
steps.instruction: With the SPT Mosquito liquid handler, dispense 150 nL of the 15 mg/mL protein sample onto each lens, then dispense 150 nL of the crystallization screen onto the same lens, achieving a 1:1 drop ratio and a final drop volume of 300 nL.

steps.title: Incubate and image drops
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a Formulatrix Rock Imager and incubate at 20 °C for 24 h (24:00:00). The imaging schedule starts with the first images after 12 h, then follows a Fibonacci‑day sequence for subsequent collections.

steps.title: Collect diffraction data
steps.instruction: Transfer crystals to the Diamond Light Source for unattended data collection. Set the detector to DECTRIS EIGER2 X 9M, beamline I04‑1, wavelength 0.9212 Å, and maintain the crystal at 100 K. Use a beam size of 60 µm × 50 µm, collect 3600 images with 0.10° oscillation per image, exposure time 0.0020 s, transmission 100 %, and flux 9.50 × 10¹¹ ph/s. Expected resolution is 1.62 Å.
